verses.text: O LORD, God of vengeance, God of vengeance, shine forth!
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你是伸冤的神；伸冤的神啊，求你發出光來！

verses.text: Rise up, O Judge of the earth, Render recompense to the proud.
verses.textZh: 審判世界的主啊，求你挺身而立，使驕傲人受應得的報應！

verses.text: How long shall the wicked, O LORD, How long shall the wicked exult?
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，惡人誇勝要到幾時呢？要到幾時呢？

verses.text: They pour forth [words], they speak arrogantly; All who do wickedness vaunt themselves.
verses.textZh: 他們絮絮叨叨說傲慢的話；一切作孽的人都自己誇張。

verses.text: They crush Your people, O LORD, And afflict Your heritage.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，他們強壓你的百姓，苦害你的產業。

verses.text: They slay the widow and the stranger And murder the orphans.
verses.textZh: 他們殺死寡婦和寄居的，又殺害孤兒。

verses.text: They have said, 'The LORD does not see, Nor does the God of Jacob pay heed.'
verses.textZh: 他們說：耶和華必不看見；雅各的神必不思念。

verses.text: Pay heed, you senseless among the people; And when will you understand, stupid ones?
verses.textZh: 你們民間的畜類人當思想；你們愚頑人到幾時才有智慧呢？

verses.text: He who planted the ear, does He not hear? He who formed the eye, does He not see?
verses.textZh: 造耳朵的，難道自己不聽見麼？造眼睛的，難道自己不看見麼？

verses.text: He who chastens the nations, will He not rebuke, [Even] He who teaches man knowledge?
verses.textZh: 管教列邦的，就是叫人得知識的，難道自己不懲治人麼？

verses.text: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, That they are a [mere] breath.
verses.textZh: 耶和華知道人的意念是虛妄的。

verses.text: Blessed is the man whom You chasten, O LORD, And whom You teach out of Your law;
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你所管教、用律法所教訓的人是有福的！

verses.text: That You may grant him relief from the days of adversity, Until a pit is dug for the wicked.
verses.textZh: 你使他在遭難的日子得享平安；惟有惡人陷在所挖的坑中。

verses.text: For the LORD will not abandon His people, Nor will He forsake His inheritance.
verses.textZh: 因為耶和華必不丟棄他的百姓，也不離棄他的產業。

verses.text: For judgment will again be righteous, And all the upright in heart will follow it.
verses.textZh: 審判要轉向公義；心裡正直的，必都隨從。

verses.text: Who will stand up for me against evildoers? Who will take his stand for me against those who do wickedness?
verses.textZh: 誰肯為我起來攻擊作惡的？誰肯為我站起抵擋作孽的？

verses.text: If the LORD had not been my help, My soul would soon have dwelt in [the abode of] silence.
verses.textZh: 若不是耶和華幫助我，我就住在寂靜之中了。

verses.text: If I should say, 'My foot has slipped,' Your lovingkindness, O LORD, will hold me up.
verses.textZh: 我正說我失了腳，耶和華啊，那時你的慈愛扶助我。

verses.text: When my anxious thoughts multiply within me, Your consolations delight my soul.
verses.textZh: 我心裡多憂多疑，你安慰我，就使我歡樂。

verses.text: Can a throne of destruction be allied with You, One which devises mischief by decree?
verses.textZh: 那藉著律例架弄殘害、在位上行奸惡的，豈能與你相交麼？

verses.text: They band themselves together against the life of the righteous And condemn the innocent to death.
verses.textZh: 他們大家聚集攻擊義人，將無辜的人定為死罪。

verses.text: But the LORD has been my stronghold, And my God the rock of my refuge.
verses.textZh: 但耶和華向來作了我的高臺；我的神作了我投靠的磐石。

verses.text: He has brought back their wickedness upon them And will destroy them in their evil; The LORD our God will destroy them.
verses.textZh: 他叫他們的罪孽歸到他們身上。他們正在行惡之中，他要剪除他們；耶和華─我們的神要把他們剪除。
